description: Electricity Production, Consumption, and Installed Capacity is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Oman Electricity Production, Consumption, and Installed Capacity for 1997-2020. Data from National Center for Statistics and Information, Sultanate of Oman. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Data extracted from annual Statistical Publication by the government. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Production, Consumption. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
